idle_policy.source_label: Slot-aware idle continuation policy (updated 2026-04-17 for M1 Max 10-core parallel agents)
idle_policy.note: Use after a top-level agent completes its main task instead of a high-frequency heartbeat cron. Priority ordering decides WHICH task to pick; it does NOT mandate sequential execution.
rules: 硬體容量：M1 Max 10 核，建議同時跑 3 個 agent（每個約 1GB RAM + 1 個 worktree）。
每次觸發先 count 當前 running agents（.claude/worktrees/ + background task ids）。若 >= max_concurrent_agents 則跳過。
slot 有空就挑新任務：(1) user-assigned pending 最高優先 (2) scheduled queue (3) discovery / research continuation。不必等 user queue 清空才 discovery。
同一個 K 編號 / 任務 id 不得同時被兩個 agent 執行（啟動前 ls experiments/ + ls .claude/worktrees/ 檢查）。
discovery pass 最多每 30 分鐘一次（整體節奏限制，不是 slot 限制）。
user queue 仍優先於 discovery — 若有 user pending，下次 slot 空出時必須優先挑 user。
每次 idle-driven continuation 或 discovery pass 之後，必須產生實際工作成果（新 agent running / git diff / knowledge 新增 / research_program 更新），不能只回報狀態。

history.change: Deprecated */4 heartbeat; introduced queue-first sequential idle continuation.
Relaxed to slot-aware concurrent execution (up to 3 parallel agents on M1 Max 10-core); priority ordering still enforced but no longer sequential.
